items.quote: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
items.claim: The animals (clean and unclean beasts, fowls, and creeping things, per 7:8) went into the ark to Noah in pairs, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.
items.actor: animals (clean and unclean beasts, fowls, creeping things)
items.action: went in two and two into the ark
